issues.description: The template declares Course.addRating(stars:) as a void method (no return value) while the solution implements it with a Bool return type (func addRating(stars: Int) -> Bool). The problem statement does not specify a return value. This signature mismatch between template and solution can confuse students about the intended API and whether they should return a Bool to indicate success.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the template and problem statement to declare addRating(stars:) -> Bool so students implement and return a Bool indicating success/failure, or (B) change the solution to use a void signature (func addRating(stars: Int)) and remove the Bool return. Prefer updating the template and problem statement to include the Bool return if indicating success is desired.
